topology_violation.behavior: terminal source worker spawned a child whose task lacked the exact source_inspector marker

p1_mechanism_evidence.join_limit: P1 timestamps and rollout-scoped session IDs establish exact aggregate cardinality, but overlapping requests do not prove a request-level bijection; P2 therefore requires branch-native session evidence and uses time only as corroboration.

p2_prospective_design.purpose: Admit the LR0 mechanism while explicitly accounting for complete zero-variance groups rejected by GRPO; never authorize weights.

topology_repair.reason: root may spawn the designated terminal source worker; that worker must be a leaf and cannot create a child

p2_prospective_design.strong_join_evidence: Proxy hashes the exact branch conversation-log UUID decoded from each request as branch_session_sha256; validator matches it to SHA256(trace call client_session_id), alongside rollout session, role, contiguous sequence, and unique request SHA. Timing is corroboration only.

raw_effective_partition_gate.effective: exactly 16 traces in two complete eight-way groups, one per family
raw_effective_partition_gate.raw: effective identities plus zero, one, or two complete rejected eight-way groups; total 16, 24, or 32
rejected_group_requirements: exactly 8 unique trace identities sharing one source/family/task key
all finite rewards exactly equal and population variance exactly zero
explicit zero_advantage filter disposition in orchestrator evidence
no partial group, no nondegenerate discarded group, no effective/rejected identity overlap
raw_effective_partition_gate.routing_scope: all raw rollouts, including rejected groups

route_and_topology_gate: one route event for every raw trace call and none extra
every attached root/coordinator call routes e33
every designated source-worker call routes exact S5 with exact marker
no child spawned by a terminal source worker
all route status 200; sequence contiguous; request SHA unique
branch_session_sha256 produces exact call/event bijection; ambiguous or missing join fails
terminal_artifact_gate: at most one node=null final call per rollout
only max_turns or delivery-cancel terminal state
exact branch-session route join and no audit-only event
node=null absent from every trainable branch and token export
report raw and effective incidence separately
p2_prospective_design.unchanged_effective_health_gates: Use all P1 likelihood, masking, reward contrast, termination, gradient, token mass, stable export, no-checkpoint, and protected-model pre/post gates on the effective 16.
p2_prospective_design.decision: Pass means mechanism admission only. Stop with no checkpoint, optimizer authorization, or evaluation continuation. Any topology, partition, routing, or health failure rejects P2.
